editorial: The Kingdom trailer is a fan level; the details clip shows classic Tomb Raider traversal. Both show normal clothed gameplay and are illustrative. The T-Rex warning is an authored illustration because the supplied clips do not establish a dinosaur encounter. The secret-code window is explicitly debunked; the Nude Raider folder is labelled PC and fan-made, with a fully opaque preview. No official nude code or PS1 mod demonstration is implied.
